description.value: Train Wreck Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom in Port Moody that brews unfiltered, full-flavoured beers on-site using traditional techniques and quality local ingredients. The sprawling event space hosts daily rotating food vendors, bar games, and live music, making it a lively community gathering spot rather than a typical pub. Brewery tours are also on offer for visitors wanting a behind-the-scenes look at the brewing operation.
